expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a spinner overlaid in the centre of an already-rendered image, suggesting a stuck/duplicated loading indicator or an image that never finished loading.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title ('Trattoria Piccol…') and its delivery price are hard-cut by the screen edge with no ellipsis or fade, making the card look broken rather than scrollable.
The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle.
The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while adjacent thumbnails in the same row are dark, creating an uneven visual rhythm and lower contrast for the white '15–25 min' badge.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cropped abruptly by the bottom tab bar with no visible name or metadata, so it can look like a clipped/broken tile.
Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text label, and the bell's red dot conveys state by colour alone.
